scope: Accepted source annotations projected into one perturbation relation; no new measurements, biological claims, independent validation or registry admission.

review_process.parent_adjudication: Source-scoped content accepted. Public query requires exact reviewed mappings and consumer bytes; candidate projector is internal and explicitly unreviewed. Source objections are binding; publication also requires final diff and head-specific CI.

resolved_objections.issue: Unmarked RA95 rows hid source-reported plus-minus magnitudes in the common uncertainty field.
resolved_objections.resolution: Generic data selectors preserve magnitude and unresolved statistic type; conflicted KM error units remain as printed.

resolved_objections.issue: Unassessed KE59 question inherited dimensionless arithmetic metadata.
resolved_objections.resolution: Unit remains null; abstention-specific interpretation and no matched control/measurement.

resolved_objections.issue: Altered assay/parameter/provider mappings could produce eligible mismatched relations.
resolved_objections.resolution: Validate source IDs, perturbation/background providers, parameter fields/units/markers, evidence/context refs and typed uncertainties. A mandatory exact review gate additionally binds curated interpretation mappings and all source references.

resolved_objections.issue: Nondetection and inconsistent stereochemical triplet needed common semantics.
resolved_objections.resolution: Normalize token/scope/detection limit without zero coercion; generic row checks read the source eligibility flag.

resolved_objections.issue: A cache claim without retained-byte verification could be mistaken for durable primary evidence.
resolved_objections.resolution: Validate witness metadata bindings; separately verify local bytes with --verify-witnesses. Public default explicitly labels cache availability unchecked.

remaining_limits: Scientific classification in the mapping is computational curation, not a proof from a source hash. Changing it requires renewed review.
Comparisons are source-rounded descriptive arithmetic, not inferential statistics or causal roles.
Source witness bytes are host-local and not redistributed. No new source requests.
Full 2017 main body, KE59 supplement and RA61 earlier-study sequence/lysine controls remain unassessed where stated.
